up: What molecules are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728477? Return the molecule's ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES, with each distinct molecule listed only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728477';
